proposals.evidence: Turner gives Bengali khādi small piece of cloth, Nepali khādi rough cloth and Hindi/Gujarati/Marathi khādī coarse cotton cloth in the first khadda branch. The Adivasi Oriya khɔdi cloth answer fits the eastern short form; the r-bearing khaddara branch is excluded. This comparative placement does not decide possible later diffusion of the cloth term.
